message.content:
Pump housing casting of aluminum, for a rotary positive displacement pump used in aircraft. Classification options: 8413.91 (parts of pumps) vs. 8803 (parts of aircraft) vs. 7616 (other aluminum articles). Parts of pumps under 8413.91 would be the principal choice, but aircraft parts are in heading 8803, which covers parts of airplanes (8802). However, Section XVI Note 1(?) and Chapter 88 notes... Heading 8803 covers "parts of goods of heading 8801 or 8802", and parts that are goods of other headings are excluded where they are pumps themselves (Note: Section XVII excludes machinery parts of general use). Section XVII Note 2 excludes parts that are articles included in headings of Sections I to XVI, other than 8409, 8431, 8473, 8487, and others. A pump housing for a pump is a part of 8413, so it's in 8413.91. CBP ruling on a similar casting: 8413.91.9085 (parts of pumps, other). Aircraft use specifically: 8413.91.9085 is "Parts of pumps: Other: Other". Subheading 8413.91.10 is for parts of pumps of 8413.20 or 8413.11, 8413.19... Option 8413.91.9085 is the commonly used one.

{"hts_code": "8413.91.9085", "reason": "An aluminum pump housing casting dedicated to a rotary positive displacement oil pump is a part of a pump of heading 8413 (excluded from Section XVII/heading 8803 by Note 2), classified in the 'other parts of pumps' provision."}
